messages:
Ellen Park: FYI - Customer ZenithHealth (ZH-990) hit a bulk activation failure during their scheduled import at 02:10 UTC. Their renewals owner is engaged and renewal discussion is in ~4 weeks. Need customer-facing status + quick exec blurb + hands-on office hours invite.
Omar Reyes: can you paste the top-level error?
Ellen Park: support dump shows `ingest-worker: write failed -> 5xx gateway` and `shard cache throttle exceeded` + a couple of timeouts for the dedicated pool. sending logs.
Nina Patel: preliminary glance points to backpressure from continuous batching on their shard causing delayed cache warm and cascading retries. This looks similar to a queue pileup, but we need eng to confirm.
Vikram Suresh: confirmed. pool-dedicated-9 had a CPU spike and sibling tenants saw elevated p99 latencies. mitigation plan: (A) disable continuous batching for ZH-990, (B) increase cache warm concurrency for their shard, (C) replay failed chunks with smaller batch size. Steps A+B in ~30-50m, replay estimated 2.5h.
OpsBot: Incident logged: INC-ZH-990-2026 severity=P2. Assigned: eng-runtime, cs-response.
Ellen Park: Nina please draft the short note to send to the customer, keep it <5 lines and include concrete ETA and office hours options. Also add an ask: provide priority seat IDs.
Nina Patel: draft -> `Hi ZenithHealth team, were aware a portion of your activation import failed this morning. Root cause: a cache-warm/API backpressure interaction during a high-volume batch. What were doing: disabling continuous batching for your tenant (ETA ~45m), warming the shard cache and replaying failed items (ETA ~3h), offering dedicated office hours for hands-on help. Well apply a temporary account credit and follow up with an RCA within 72 hours. Please reply with any priority seat IDs for immediate attention.`
Omar Reyes: couple of edits: replace "warming the shard cache" -> "warming your shard cache" and add note about safety: `we will dedupe writes and rate-limit replays to avoid duplicates`.
Nina Patel: updated and sending.
CSM - Diego: sent to ZenithHealth (ticket #92011). They replied: "Thanks. Priority seats: 8812, 8813. Prefer office hours Wed 09:00 PT."
Ellen Park: action list: @Omar disable batching + change cache concurrency (ETA 45m). @Vikram reserve CPU for replay window. @Diego confirm office hours invite and get customer seat list. @Nina prepare the 2-line exec summary. @Finance apply interim credit. We'll also surface a per-tenant activation progress widget in the dashboard for them to watch.
Vikram Suresh: CPU reserved. Replay scheduled to start after cache warm complete; monitoring for duplicates enabled.
OpsBot: Change applied: continuous batching disabled for ZH-990 by Omar Reyes at 1746200300.
Omar Reyes: started cache adjustments; warming in progress. ETA for warm completion ~25m.
Nina Patel: quick exec summary suggestion -> "We experienced a partial ingestion disruption for ZenithHealth caused by cache warmup contention during a large import. Immediate mitigations are applied; replay and validation are in progress; were providing a temporary credit and will deliver a full RCA within 72 hours."
Ellen Park: good. Diego please share the above to your buyer and attach office hours invite. Also flag renewal owner with potential churn signal.
CSM - Diego: buyer updated and invite sent for Wed 09:00 PT. Customer acknowledged and requested we prioritize seat 8812 first.
Omar Reyes: replay running, initial progress shows activations rising from ~50% -> ~80% after first tranche. I'll post a +60m status.
Nina Patel: closing notes for this thread: RCA draft due in 72h, customer-friendly summary in 8h, credits applied within 24h. We'll run a post-incident feedback pulse 7 days after resolution: `https://forms.redwood-inference.com/incident-feedback?tenant=ZH-990`.
Ellen Park: keeping this as the single source for all customer-facing comms. Please react when you've read. :white_check_mark:
Omar Reyes: :white_check_mark:
Vikram Suresh: :thumbsup:
CSM - Diego: :handshake:
Nina Patel: :sparkles:
